content:
To get the complete benefits of Microsoft Defender XDR, we recommend deploying all
supported services. Here are some of the key benefits of full deployment:
Incidents are identified and correlated based on alerts and event signals from all available
sensors and service-specific analysis capabilities
Automated investigation and remediation (AIR) playbooks apply across various entity
types, including devices, mailboxes, and user accounts
A more comprehensive advanced hunting schema can be queried for event and entity
data from devices, mailboxes, and other entities
Each supported service that you deploy provides an extremely rich set of raw signals and
correlated information. While limited deployment doesn't cause Microsoft Defender XDR
functionality to turn off, its ability to provide comprehensive visibility across your endpoints,
apps, data, and identities is affected. At the same time, any remediation capabilities only apply
to entities that are managed by the services you've deployed.
The table below lists how each supported service provides additional data, opportunities to
obtain additional insight by correlating the data, and better remediation and response
capabilities.
